rules: Return pairs are derived from equal normalized joint-state inputs; return_leg metadata itself is ignored when pairing.
A return pair fails deterministic replay if either joint-state SHA or full snapshot SHA differs.
Every adjacent sample transition requires explicit engineering disposition and evidence references; no invented jump threshold grants PASS.
Continuity PASS requires every adjacent transition PASS.
Reversibility PASS requires every derived return pair to match and explicit engineering review PASS.
Motion review is candidate/sweep evidence only and never implies owner acceptance or production approval.
